skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and apply fundamental concepts of computer networks, including network architecture, communication protocols, and network models.
Master techniques for data transmission, including encoding, modulation, error detection and correction, and data control.
Comprehend and implement basic elements of Local Area Networks (LANs), including Ethernet standards, network devices, and wireless LANs.
Understand and apply techniques for Wide Area Networks (WANs), including PSTN, leased lines, ISDN, and DSL technologies.
Explain and utilize TCP, UDP, IP protocols, subnetting techniques, and common Internet services.
Develop the ability to solve problems related to computer networks and data communication in practical scenarios.
Enhance skills in working collaboratively in groups to solve network-related problems.
Foster the ability to independently seek and understand information related to computer networks.
Improve critical thinking skills to analyze and solve network-related issues.
Develop skills in presenting network-related concepts and solutions effectively.
